qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake: The last FOL statement p_0(Jemma) → p_8(Jemma) says 'If Jemma attends conferences, then she pursues an academic career.' The natural language statement is the same, so on the surface it looks correct. However, attending conferences does not necessarily imply pursuing an academic career — one might attend conferences while working in industry or independently. The implication is too strong. The mistake is that the FOL implication assumes a one-directional necessity (attending conferences → academic career) that isn't justified by the natural language context, which likely allows for people in industry to attend conferences too. So the FOL incorrectly encodes a sufficient condition as a necessary one.
